en.text: An apple is round in shape.

indices: 林檎(りんご) の 形(かたち)[01] は 丸い[01]

original: 地球が丸いという事実を誰も否定できない。

en.text: No one can deny the fact that the earth is round.

en.text: The teacher taught them that the earth is round.
